Overview

Niterói is a city in RJ with a population of 515,317. Across Guanabara Bay from Rio, known for its high quality of life, the Niemeyer-designed MAC museum, and stunning coastal views. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 7a growing zone supports Mild — wide variety of vegetables, many fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively high.
